content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a [product_name] [article_no]. The program is currently set up in ladder diagram, but I'm new to programming and don't understand the other diagram options. Additionally, I am having trouble with a text block system. During upload, the system shows messages indicating text blocks are missing connections or termination. I would appreciate any advice on this. I've connected the device to Q1. Thanks.
Hi [user_name], Could you please write your question in English? English is the language used in this forum. Best regards [user_name]

Hi [user_name], Here's a clear explanation: 1) To access extra functions for the [product_name] LCD display and [product_name] TD, enable advanced features from the FILE menu under "Message Text Settings" and select 'Use new features'. 2) Programming [product_name] in Function Block Diagram (FBD) is generally easier than in ladder diagram (LAD). 3) In [product_name], every function block needs an output connection to work properly after compiling and downloading to hardware. 4) The program might work in simulation without outputs connected, but it won't compile or download to the device. 5) For digital outputs such as message text, you can use: - an output (like Q1-Q16), but this isn't always ideal, - a digital marker or flag, though this can use up valuable resources, - an OPEN CONNECTOR (X), which is usually the best option. 6) If you have multiple message texts, you can connect them all to a single Open Connector by using OR gates. 7) Try creating a simple program with one digital input to activate a message text, connected to an Open Connector (X) in FBD. Then use the converter to change it to LAD. 8) This will show you how to handle termination with an Open Connector in LAD. Hope this helps! [Have a nice day!] - [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: People face challenges setting up text block termination in [product_name] TD hardware, particularly when working with ladder diagrams. There is a lack of straightforward guidance for beginners on configuring message text settings and output terminations. The existing help documentation in the software is not sufficient for novice users, which leads to confusion between simulation and actual hardware operations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want clear, beginner-oriented instructions on setting up text blocks and output terminations in [product_name] programming, especially when using ladder diagrams with [product_name] TD.
